system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

As a bonus action, you spend 1 Superiority Die to command all members of your Squad to take a defensive position, moving them away from danger. All members of your Squad can move up to half their movement speed away from a hostile creature. This movement does not trigger attacks of opportunity and they gain DR (Damage Reduction) equal to the result of your superiority die until the beginning of your next turn.
